{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'

# Filter out rows where customer_age == -1 (sentinel for missing data)

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = df_filtered['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f"Mean age of customers (excluding sentinel -1 values): {mean_age}")"}
